scope: One short same-chat, no-tools recovery control; structural context path; host load before/during/after

runtime_readback.system_manager_query: unit not loaded in system systemd plane
runtime_readback.runtime_scope_limit: Process CWD, startup time, installed package and compiled paths agree; in-memory loaded-module identity was not introspected.

context_path_readback.agent_context: getTokenBudgetBreakdown computes max context, instruction, schema, summary, and message counts; active-tool accounting excludes deferred-undiscovered/non-direct definitions.
context_path_readback.graph: Emits ON_CONTEXT_USAGE snapshots around model invocation.
context_path_readback.librechat_handler: Captures latest visible snapshot in contextUsageSink.
context_path_readback.mongo_persistence_gate: buildResponseMetadata attaches contextUsage only when primary model usage follows that snapshot.
context_path_readback.stopped_run_observation: The stopped assistant rows have no metadata or usage; exact token split is therefore absent from Mongo.
context_path_readback.causal_limit: This explains why aborted-turn token breakdown is not persisted; it does not establish why the model failed to dispatch MCP or complete text.

same_chat_control.control_kind: negative control; explicitly requested no tools
same_chat_control.reconnect_readback: The same saved conversation reopened; its earlier user turn was visible and assistant response was blank.
same_chat_control.interpretation: LibreChat accepts and persists a follow-up in the recovered chat, but this bounded control did not complete a response. A 92% live context reading appears even with a 35-token no-tools prompt; the static instruction/schema split remains unmeasured.

next_action: Before another inference, expose or capture the existing live ON_CONTEXT_USAGE structural fields (instruction tokens, effective tool count/schema tokens, message tokens and available budget), then change only the demonstrated context contributor. Preserve the full 11-tool catalog and do not claim MCP or conversation acceptance from this no-tools control.
